title: OptimalMC
description: An optimised, light weighted, good looking version of minecraft with fabric modloader.
body:
**Love Minecraft but hate lag? Tired of lag, stutters, and FPS drops?**

**OptimalMC** is an optimized, lightweight, and visually enhanced version of Minecraft, powered by the Fabric modloader. Designed for players who seek both performance and aesthetics, this modpack enhances gameplay with carefully selected client-side mods.

With a strong focus on optimization, **OptimalMC** boosts **FPS**, **reduces lag**, and ensures **smooth gameplay**, making it perfect for both low-end and high-end systems. At the same time, it improves the overall Minecraft experience with **visual enhancements**, **better UI**, and **quality-of-life** features—all without compromising the game's **original charm**.

Whether you're exploring, building, or adventuring, this pack ensures a seamless and enjoyable gameplay experience on both low-end and high-end systems.

Experience Minecraft the way it was meant to be: **fast**, **beautiful**, and **immersive**.
